name: switch
title: Switch
description: A toggle whose thumb stretches toward the other side while you hold it (squash & stretch), drags across under your finger and throws a soft halo as it springs over, while the track cross-fades. iOS, Material 3 and sun/moon icon looks.
summary: A toggle whose thumb squashes and stretches toward the other side while held.
behavior: Tap to flip, or drag the thumb across. Passing label (and description) turns it into a settings row.
The thumb stretches toward its destination while pressed, springs over with a soft halo, and the track cross-fades.
A light impact on every flip; turn it off with haptics={false}.
A switch role with checked and disabled state, labelled by accessibilityLabel or label.
props: Look of the track and thumb.
Sun / moon or ✕ / check inside the thumb (variant="icon").
Turns it into a settings row with the switch on the right.
Style for the pressable — the switch itself, or the whole settings row when label is set.
